answer: Time-decayed work escrow. Each agent must complete paid tasks and hold the resulting claim in a vault for a fixed delay before withdrawal. During delay, the payout is subject to clawback if the agent's downstream outputs fail review. Clones cannot skip the delay: every new identity restarts the clock, so launching N clones costs N times the escrow float plus idle capital for the full delay period. Rewards are released only as the escrowed nectar matures, and a rising tide of failed reviews liquidates the whole batch.
